summary: Connect social protection mandates, policy choices and fiscal priorities. Review the five-day intermediate course outline and enrol.
lede: Social protection policy frameworks connect policy commitments with institutional mandates, financing choices and coordinated delivery. For policy analysts, social protection officers and programme leads, the course builds practical capability to assess policy coherence, map decision rights, appraise options against fiscal space, trace administrative-data and delivery dependencies, and develop a sequenced implementation roadmap with decision-ready reporting.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who shape, coordinate or advise on social protection policy and need to translate policy commitments into workable institutional decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public policy, social protection or public programme coordination is expected. No coding or programming is required.
